nlmixr2extra events

Source: vignettes/events.Rmd
events.Rmd

Introduction

rxode2 provides a small event bus: packages emit an event when a user-facing operation finishes, and any package can listen for it with rxode2::rxEventListen(). The main consumer is nlmixr2log, which records every fit, simulation and result as a run, but a listener can be any function. See ?rxode2::rxEventListen for the bus itself.

The key rule of the bus is that events are only delivered from the outermost operation. Every emitting function enters a shared operation scope, and an event is dropped when it is emitted inside one. That matters a great deal for nlmixr2extra: its drivers (bootstrapFit(), multistart(), covarSearchAuto(), …) run tens or hundreds of nlmixr2() fits and rxSolve() calls internally. Each driver enters the scope, so its internal fits and solves are silent, and on the way out it emits one event that describes the whole call. A logger then stores one entry per driver call instead of one run per internal fit.

Everything here is a no-op when the installed rxode2 has no event bus, and nothing is emitted when no listener is registered.

Which event a driver emits

On exit, a driver looks at what it returned and picks one event:

  • the input fit itself, changed in place, gives fitUpdate – a new version of that fit’s run;
  • a different fit gives fitComplete with source set to the driver’s kind – a new run linked to the input fit (object);
  • anything else (a data frame, a list of results, a plot) gives one fitResult carrying a fit-free summary of the result.

When a result holds a best fit (multistart()’s $best), that fit is also announced with fitComplete, linked to the input fit, so it can be kept as its own run.

Driver Event(s) what / source / kind
bootstrapFit() (default returnType = "model") fitUpdate bootstrap
bootstrapFit(returnType = "fitList"/"modelList") fitResult bootstrap
preconditionFit() fitUpdate (always) covariance
multistart(fit) fitResult, then fitComplete for $best multistart
multistart(model, data) fitComplete for $best, then fitResult multistart
covarSearchAuto() fitResult covarSearch
resSearch() fitResult resSearch
iivSearch() fitResult iivSearch
rerunTopN() nothing (refits are silent) –
linearize() fitComplete linearize
profile() (fit method) fitResult profile
profileFixed() fitResult profile
profileLlp() fitResult profile
lassoCoefficients() fitResult lasso
adaptivelassoCoefficients() fitResult lasso
adjustedlassoCoefficients() fitResult lasso
regularmodel() fitComplete lasso
bootplot() fitResult (the plot) bootplot

The kind is stored in what for fitUpdate, in source for fitComplete and in kind for fitResult.

Payloads

Listeners are called as fun(event, ...): the event name, then the payload fields as named arguments.

fitUpdate

Field Value
fit the input fit, as changed by the driver
original the same fit (it was changed in place)
name NULL
what the driver’s kind, e.g. "bootstrap" or "covariance"
inPlace TRUE
call the driver call

fitComplete

Field Value
fit the new fit (linearize(), regularmodel(), or a result’s best fit)
object the input fit it came from; NULL when the driver started from a model
call the driver call
objName NULL
source the driver’s kind, e.g. "linearize"

fitResult

Field Value
fit the input fit (or the best fit when the driver started from a model)
result a fit-free summary of what the driver returned (see below)
kind the driver’s kind, e.g. "profile"
call the driver call

The result is built so that a logger can store it cheaply:

  • every fit inside the result is replaced by list(OBJF = <objective function>, parFixedDf = <parameter table>), read from the fit without computing anything;
  • data frames and ggplot objects are kept as they are;
  • functions and environments are dropped;
  • lists are summarized up to four levels deep, and the original class of a classed list is kept in the "nlmixr2extraClass" attribute.

The call of every event is normalized by rxode2: its head is the driver’s name, and large values inlined in it are replaced by markers, so a recorded call never embeds a data set or a fit.

What is not emitted

  • Internal work. The fits, refits and solves a driver runs are inside its scope and emit nothing – not the bootstrap fits, not the multistart candidates, not the profile steps, not the covariate search candidates. This includes bootstrapFit() when it is called by bootplot().
  • Nested drivers. A driver called from inside another driver (or from inside any other emitting operation, such as nlmixr2()) is itself silent; only the outermost call reports.
  • Errors. When a driver fails, it leaves the scope and emits nothing.
  • Non-fit inputs. A driver whose input is not a fit emits only when its result holds a best fit (as multistart(model, data) does). So rerunTopN(), whose input is an iivSearch() result, emits nothing; its refits are simply kept silent.
  • A best fit that is the input. When a result’s best fit is the input fit itself, only the fitResult is emitted.
  • Unsummarizable results. If summarizing the result fails, the driver leaves the scope without an event rather than breaking the call.

Listening

A listener is a function function(event, ...). This one records the event name and the driver’s kind:

library(nlmixr2extra)

events <- list()
rxode2::rxEventListen("demo", function(event, ...) {
  p <- list(...)
  kind <- if (!is.null(p$what)) p$what else if (!is.null(p$source)) p$source else p$kind
  events[[length(events) + 1L]] <<- data.frame(event = event, kind = kind)
})

A fit to drive. It is run inside rxode2::rxEventScope() here so that only the drivers below are recorded (otherwise nlmixr2() would report this fit with its own fitComplete, when nlmixr2est has the event hooks):

one.compartment <- function() {
  ini({
    tka <- log(1.57)
    tcl <- log(2.72)
    tv <- log(31.5)
    eta.ka ~ 0.6
    eta.cl ~ 0.3
    eta.v ~ 0.1
    add.sd <- 0.7
  })
  model({
    ka <- exp(tka + eta.ka)
    cl <- exp(tcl + eta.cl)
    v <- exp(tv + eta.v)
    linCmt() ~ add(add.sd)
  })
}

fit <- rxode2::rxEventScope(
  nlmixr2(one.compartment, nlmixr2data::theo_sd, est = "focei",
          control = list(print = 0))
)
#> [====|====|====|====|====|====|====|====|====|====] 0:00:00
#> [====|====|====|====|====|====|====|====|====|====] 0:00:00
#> [====|====|====|====|====|====|====|====|====|====] 0:00:00
#> calculating covariance matrix
#> [====|====|====|====|====|====|====|====|====|====] 0:00:00 
#> done

Now call a few drivers. Each runs many fits internally, but reports once (or twice, for multistart()’s best start):

preconditionFit(fit)
lin <- linearize(fit)
prof <- profile(fit, which = data.frame(tka = log(c(1.4, 1.6))), method = "fixed")
ms <- multistart(fit, control = list(n = 2, spread = 0.3, screen = "none",
                                     cacheDir = NA, refitBest = FALSE))
do.call(rbind, events)
#>         event       kind
#> 1   fitUpdate covariance
#> 2 fitComplete  linearize
#> 3   fitResult    profile
#> 4   fitResult multistart
#> 5 fitComplete multistart

The heavier drivers report the same way; for example, this records a single fitUpdate (kind bootstrap) for the 100 bootstrap fits:

bootstrapFit(fit, nboot = 100)

When you are done, remove the listener:

rxode2::rxEventUnlisten("demo")

Full logging

For a complete log of fits, simulations and driver results – with each driver call stored as one entry linked to the fit it started from – use nlmixr2log, which listens to these events for you.
